text:
Riley Park: Venaro Labs just sent invoice `VL-3317` for $8,760 but the PDF has no PO. Vendor says 15% service fee if delayed beyond 5 days.
Nora Kim: Can you drop the invoice number + vendor ref here?
Riley Park: Invoice VL-3317, vendor ref VN-77-2026. Line items: model evaluation hours, data transfer, model-hosting delta.
Samir Patel: Looks like this should map to PO-8034 (Research infra). I see PO-8034 in Coupa but vendor didn't include it.
Danielle Wu: Coupa auto-match failed. APBot flagged it: NO_PO -> HOLD.
APBot: Invoice VL-3317 flagged: PAYMENT_HOLD. AP ticket created: AP-54320. Required approvers: Theo Grant (Research lead), Nora Kim (AP).
Theo Grant: We used a blanket PO for Venaro earlier; vendor must have used the wrong billing template. I can sign as owner of cost center 300-RD.
Nora Kim: Need GL code and charge breakdown to route. Riley can you confirm GL?
Riley Park: GL `6105`, subacct `RD-03`. Uploaded vendor email and the invoice screenshot to the ticket.
Samir Patel: Vendor offered a 2% early-payment discount if we pay by Friday, but invoice must reference PO for AP to process automatically.
Danielle Wu: If vendor can't reissue with PO-8034, we can do AP override with VP approval. That will take >1 day though.
Theo Grant: I'll approve the override to avoid the service fee if FP&A ok's the cashflow.
Nora Kim: Kicking FP&A review to Samir. @Samir Patel please ok cash hit.
Samir Patel: Reviewed -- we can absorb $8,760 this cycle. Approve override. Add note "Venaro billed missing PO; request reissue and update templates." in AP ticket.
APBot: All required approvals recorded. PAYMENT_HOLD cleared. Scheduled payment: 2026-04-02 run. Reminder: follow up with vendor to reissue or we withhold future payments until template fixed.
Riley Park: I'll confirm payment schedule with Venaro and request corrected invoice template.
Theo Grant: Thanks. Nora, please close AP-54320 after payment posts and confirm vendor updated billing contact.
Nora Kim: Will do. Marking for follow-up on vendor template update.
